name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: Winter storm warnings in US Rocky Mountains; no deadly cold wave
state: The US National Weather Service issued winter storm warnings for mountain areas of Colorado, Wyoming, Utah and Montana on 1–2 Nov, mainly above 10,000 ft (NWS alerts). No deadly cold wave or storm causing widespread outages had been reported as of 4 Nov, and the Met Office had no warnings in force.
for_you: Follow national weather service warnings when travelling in mountain areas.
rubric_hit: No top-tier cold warnings across a major region = Normal

sources.title: Unofficial Networks — Winter storm warnings issued for Colorado, Wyoming, Utah and Montana

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
